content:
[L] high | right side panel, State row | The "waiting-engin…" chip is clipped mid-word at the panel's right edge, truncating "waiting-engineer".
[L] high | right side panel, top row | The "spam" status chip and the panel edge run to the very window boundary with the last chip nearly cut off at the right margin.
[L] high | bottom of conversation list | Row #505 "Data export format question" is clipped in half by the window bottom edge, leaving a truncated line of text.
[L] high | composer strip | The reply composer spans only the reading-pane column while the details panel above extends higher with a floating partial separator line at ~y=500, so the two columns' bottom regions collide visually with mismatched bounds.
[L] med | left filter card, search field | Search input text is truncated as "search conver…" because the field is too narrow next to the "#" and "Apply" controls.
[L] med | composer, To/Cc/Bcc rows | The label column ("To", "Cc", "Bcc") sits far left while inputs are indented, but the "Bcc" row has an extra-wide dead gap compared to "To" and "Cc" rows which are tightly packed.
[L] med | details panel, date separator row | A stray rounded outline fragment appears at the far left of the date-separator row (~x=345, y=498), an orphaned clipped element.
[S] high | left rail view tabs | "All 6 / Active 3 / Pending 2" are on one row but "Closed 1" wraps onto a second line, breaking the tab row rhythm and alignment.
[S] med | conversation list rows | Vertical gaps between list cards are wildly uneven (tight between #501/#502, huge dead zones between #502–#503 and #503–#504).
[S] med | left rail filter card | The "Filters / Reset" row is inconsistently indented relative to the search row above it, and both sit with unequal insets from the card edge.
[S] med | details panel form rows | Status/Assignee/Priority/State chips have inconsistent row heights and vertical gaps; the Snooze row is cramped against the Tags row while State has excess air.
[S] low | header | The floating circle icon at top-right is misaligned with the "Copilot" label baseline and has no visible grouping or affordance.
[H] high | details panel | Status/Assignee/Priority/State/Tags/Snooze labels and chip values have near-identical weight and size, so field labels do not read as labels versus editable values.
[H] med | conversation list | Sender name, subject, assignee, timestamp, and status badge all render at nearly the same size/weight — no clear primary line (subject) versus metadata hierarchy.
[H] med | composer meta line | "reply — sent to the customer · Ctrl+Enter sends" is tiny low-contrast text sharing the row with the large "Send" button at unequal baselines.
[C] high | center of reading pane | A large empty dead zone separates the details card from the composer (date row and orphaned fragment floating in whitespace), reading as unfinished scaffolding.
[C] med | whole screen | There is no visible toolbar, search, or global navigation bar at the top of the window; the app begins abruptly with the header title, reading as a debug harness rather than a product.
[C] med | conversation list | Mixed card treatment: #501 has a filled selected background with a left accent bar, others are unbordered white rows with floating badges — inconsistent row chrome.
[C] low | left rail | Duplicate "All" heading ("All" pill tab then an "All" heading + "6 of 6 conversations") wastes vertical space and repeats information.
VERDICT: unprofessional — clipped text, broken tab wrapping, uneven list rhythm, and half-finished panel/composer boundaries make this read as a debug build, not a shippable helpdesk client.
